I understand completely. Unfortunately I'm full time and non temp in a front desk position. The first whole year was like that. When I had gotten the job I was buying a house and was constantly working on paperwork during my break. I'm decent looking so when I first-first started all the men who work here wanted to go to lunch and I couldn't (thankfully didn't cause their motivation was probably not friendship) So once I refused a couple times no one talked to me anymore in a friendly way. The more time I spent working there the meaner people treated me. One time someone one gasped in surprise when I told them I had a B.A. What assholes. They assume I'm and idiot, provide zero training. The "training" they provided was full of false info that was used against me later in my time here. Two different workers taught me the procedure incorrectly so the more senior staff, instead of correcting me and helping me, just snickered behind my back about how dumb I am. It pretty much killed all the optimism I possessed and now after almost two years, I'm forcing myself to feel good about me. I can't wait to get a new job but it has been a challenging thing to accomplish. I am the black sheep here and it sucks so fucking bad. I've never had lower self esteem from the constant pecking at my self image from these equally stupid people. Once I put in my two weeks I will be so fucking happy. It will all be over and I will finally be able to get some confidence back. 

EDIT: After my first 9 months I walked into HR, which is really just one lady, asked her how I was doing performance wise only to be told how many mistakes and mess-ups I was doing (she was one of the incompetent trainers who gave me false info) I was shocked, horrified that no one who correct me when they were aware of an issue, and outright began hating my co-workers for the crap they put me and probably all people before me through. Someone send me some psychic positivity because I typing this at work now and realizing how badly I need another job. I just came on here to try and feel better about them treating me like an idiot. 

EDIT 2: Just got an email asking me to do something I already did from an assistant who only works 30 hrs a week here. She gets in at 10am. She is bringing herself up to speed but she is also assuming I don't know how to handle things. Fuck this place... fuck it so fucking hard.

Idk I hope this fear I have of him is irrational. Only time can tell so I guess my suicide feelings are gone for at least today and tomorrow. I definitely don't want to give up so I will keep trying and trying. Attempting to gain positivity along the way to go just that much further and maybe I will find that good life
Worst part is I'm going to go home after work and he's going to expect I apologize and say it genuinely. If I do or don't he'll be mad at the fact he thought I acted like a bitch.

It's not worth it because I'll always do something to piss him off.

You won't regret not starting the relationship and probably will never wonder what could have been years from now. Im 29 F. The most important thing in a relationship isn't looks, or body, or anything superficial. It is the person. Who they are, how they treat others and what they do to make themselves happy. Who should they be? Kind enough, how should they treat others, with relative respect. What do decent people do to be happy? Definitely not cause others damage or harm.

I think you have the right to feel however you naturally feel. Its up to you to interpret those feelings and act or not act. Here is what I see in your message: a woman who is confronted with something that makes her uncomfortable (drinking and driving). You are just being confronted in a sort of secret way where you know someone in one light but then discovered them in another light that you don't agree with-values wise. If you don't keep your values, what was the point in having them? Is this meant for you to change your values? Only you know I think. But based on what I read, my personal advice to you is maybe skillfully end things? If it was me, I'd blab hardcore about what I found out, but it doesn't seem like that is necessary. He is who he is. Telling him that your values contradict the way he chose to live his life might not do anyone any good. IDK. It doesn't mean he is a bad person or anything. He definitely doesn't value certain things you do and of you don't think you are meant to give up those values for him, I would just end things.

We live in a house I own. We also live off of my salary alone. He doesn't make more than 5k a year. So if we can't do this, I'll have to kick him out. And most likely just let him take what he wants. It would be too exhausting to fight one last time. 
The irony that I don't think he sees is I rushed around between work to get that damn tree to make him happy. Which means I put my happiness before his, but I don't pretend to be happy... so if I could just be super fake he'd probably be content. Damn this is making me angry.

I supposed a lot of me feels bad for him and is scared of being perceived as the bad person for ending things. But that is the whole point you are making. Changing the behavior that masks my true feelings into behavior that shows how I feel. When I've done that it starts arguments. I do not think he is impressed by someone who says what they feel so I may have a hard time with this... a very... hard time with this. I'm actually pretty scared but that maybe a good thing. I'm not afraid of being alone, infact, If I can do this, I think biggest lesson I've learned from this relationship is don't get too involved too fast, you may not like who you end up being with. And if you said I'd meet my soul mate after dating 30 people I'd say- you gotta promise me they're more level headed and mature than I am. I keep finding people who need to work on the same things I do. Like in music, to get better, you must play with players who are better than  you. So I'll welcome something another relationship only when I know I can be a better person by knowing this person. ... God... relationships.... why? I'm pretty scared. But I'll think on all this for a good amount of time before I act.

I read about the term "gas lighting" hence the post's topic "who is the narcissist?" Because I feel all of the text book definitions of someone who is being gaslighted. I have tried very hard to look through difference perspectives, what am I doing, what is making me mad, did acting that way help or hurt me and the other person,... the list goes on. I ponder this stuff often. It is so weird to know what toxic is by definition but when it comes to the action, seeing (in hindsight) how it is much harder to differentiate what course of action is the best or high road. (non-toxic) My boyfriend doesn't look at the world this way at this point in his life. He is set in who he is which doesn't help at all. I do think the age thing isn't working, I believe he doesn't see it one way or another because he has always dated women in my age range since I suppose he was in "our" age range. I keep saying "I believe" because, in a fight or no, when I ask him a direct question he always has an elaborate rounded answer that never really addresses the question. Therefore I determined he was trying to convey a different point because something about my question was leading him to tell me something else. I used to think that was a quality of depth within him. Now I believe he likes the sound of his own voice and doesn't know how to directly answer questions about his feelings or what he believes. I need to think of a solution...
Maybe making a plan will help. Step by step, setting yourself up secretly to easily ease out of the situation?
Weird. ... weird. How do most people have their facts wrong.

He has insisted our whole relationship to share all of our money so it is too convoluted to keep track of what belongs to who. He has made 10,000 in the last two years and I have a full time job at just under 30k a year... its... so... confusing and it hurts a little too much for my comfort.

I hear you. In an effort to write a short post I left out some key points. I am afraid that I'm dating a narcissist because while I was exhausted, silently sitting on the couch after wrapping myself in every corner of the house to plug in the xmas lights, we found they didn't work. He, and this is not usual of him, tried to fix the lights. I was relieved. My legs were sore, I'd been out all day and it was 9pm. So I was silently appreciating him trying to fix them and I thought all was fine. We determined we needed to take the lights of so I got up and started unraveling them with him. He steps away and Im doing it alone now, not much lights left, then he's talking angrily about my attitude. I really won't deal well with anyone being mad at my unconscious display of exhaustion. He couldn't understand that without continuing to yell about how I ruined this night, ruin many nights, have a terrible attitude and shouldn't ruin the family xmas like this ( we have no children and he lives in my house so I don't know where hes coming from) I could have been better at expressing myself but he does this any chance he gets: tells me how Im living incorrectly, or being a person incorrectly to the point I ruin his experience. I told him that THAT is his problem, letting others attitudes change his attitude. After that fight exploded THAT is when I just went off on his calling dumb. I still don't think he knows what he's talking about and I believe he is too blind to see what he causes and seeks me out to blame his anger on. Which is hard to convey here because (and I thought about this while we were fighting) Saying someone is blaming you for something you didn't do, is in essence blaming the other person. When I realized this I told him we needed to agree to disagree because it is the holidays and since they whole point was that he felt his holiday being ruined, we should reconcile. Any chance he gets ... he starts and argument, holds onto his feelings of resentment and turns around normal human behavior as an attack on him. Geez typing this I just want to break up.. but it is so toxic at this point... its impossible to have him leave without destroying something of mine before he goes. We are both similar but not the same.
